title: 美债5%不是顶：5.1%才可能，市场要等什么信号？
speaker: Michael Tang

segments.en: And so it does come down to, I believe, monetary credibility.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，归根结底在于货币政策的可信度。

segments.en: So Michael, just in terms of absolute levels right now on yield, would you advise, for people looking at 5%, and we're here for the first time in what let's call it 19, 20 years, is this good value right now on US Treasuries?
segments.zh: Michael，就目前的收益率绝对水平而言，你会建议吗？对于关注5%的人来说，我们这是19、20年来第一次达到这个水平，现在美国国债有配置价值吗？

segments.en: I think, of course, of the three data points you mentioned over the next week or so. Yeah, I think, if you look at it, maybe historically, maybe this argument, it looks reasonable.
segments.zh: 当然，你提到了未来一周左右的三个数据点。是的，我认为，如果从历史角度看，这个论点可能看起来是合理的。

segments.en: I think, though, there is a big sentiment angle going through the market at the moment as well.
segments.zh: 不过，我认为目前市场也存在很大的情绪因素。

segments.en: And that's why I do think it's important, maybe for the market to find some kind of clear top before investors are a bit more comfortable going back in.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我认为，市场可能需要找到某种明确的顶部，投资者才会更放心地重新进入。

segments.en: So I think it's relatively easy to sit around and say maybe 5%, I think 5% certainly is probably quite an important psychological level as well.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，坐在这里说5%很容易，我认为5%肯定也是一个相当重要的心理水平。

segments.en: But I would argue that just given the amount of momentum in the market, I imagine there's a favorite of stopping out at the moment as well.
segments.zh: 但我会说，鉴于市场的动量，我想目前也有很多人倾向于止损。

segments.en: So between that and how the market's feeling, there's a lot of factors driving your tire.
segments.zh: 所以在这两者之间以及市场情绪的影响下，有很多因素在驱动市场。

segments.en: And 5% is maybe one level, but 5.05, 5.1, I think all very possible if the market was very, very uncomfortable.
segments.zh: 5%可能是一个水平，但如果市场非常非常不安，5.05%、5.1%我认为都是非常可能的。

segments.en: Right. So I think, ultimately, it's about seeing a clear top, and I think a lot of that will come from events.
segments.zh: 对。所以我认为，最终关键在于看到明确的顶部，而我认为这很大程度上将取决于事件。

segments.en: Everyone's talking about Scott Besson, and the announcement this week, 6 billion was announced.
segments.zh: 大家都在谈论斯科特·贝森，本周宣布了60亿。
